documents: Unofficial transcripts; final official records upon matriculation

requirements.note: U.S. citizenship or permanent residency required, plus English proficiency, scientific undergraduate degree and previous laboratory research. Transcripts in another language require certified word-by-word English translation.

international.note: Published minimum eligibility requires U.S. citizenship or permanent resident status.

funding.note: Five years of institutional funding with good standing, independent of laboratory choice; full tuition scholarship and medical, dental and vision insurance. Undated published stipend $48,500.
